_metadata.description: Requirements for the reusable proto-surface fact RPC.

requirements.title: Describe scenario proto surface
requirements.description: DescribeScenarioProtos returns a structured inventory of scenario-owned files, versions, domains, services, RPCs, messages, fields, imports, annotations, adoption signals, and transport world.

validation.notes: Assert deterministic ordering and exact ProtoSurface output from descriptor fixtures.

requirements.title: Expose descriptor loading as a seam
requirements.description: Descriptor and scenario filesystem loading are behind interfaces so validation tests can inject fixtures without mutating the real fleet descriptor.

validation.notes: Service tests use fake descriptor loaders and scenario locators.
